source: Pew Research Center. 2010. "U.S. Religious Knowledge Survey."
method: qn46 asked all respondents to pick which of five options is NOT one of the Ten Commandments; the correct answer is "do unto others as you would have them do unto you" (the Golden Rule, from the Sermon on the Mount, not the Ten Commandments). Don't know/refused excluded from each row's denominator. Broken out by the respondent's own present religion (qn20). Groups with fewer than 30 valid respondents are omitted. Weighted by the dataset's own `weight` variable.
